name: Sakimori Gentarou
source:
He is the 17th head of the Sakimori family, a renowned lineage of rope makers that has continued since the Edo period.
His skills as a rope artist are top-notch. He has trained numerous apprentices.
He continues to make a living by teaching rope bondage techniques in the village.
